How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-18 · partnership Qualys
    Cognizant joins the Qualys managed risk operations centre (mROC) alliance

    Qualys announced on 2026-11-18 that Cognizant had joined its Global mROC Alliance and will offer four managed services built on Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Management: risk quantification and advisory, onboarding and integration, managed risk monitoring, and managed remediation. The release describes the service as using Qualys InstaScan, Agent Val and TruRisk Eliminate. Performance figures in the release are Qualys's own. Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-08-03 · launch Qualys
    Qualys launches InstaScan for detection without a new scan

    Qualys announced InstaScan, which checks existing inventory and telemetry in Enterprise TruRisk Management against newly published advisories to identify affected assets within minutes without running a new scan. Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  3. 2026-05-14 · certification Qualys
    Qualys TotalCloud receives FedRAMP High authorization

    Qualys announced FedRAMP High authorization for TotalCloud, its cloud-native application protection product, sponsored by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration; the release states the Qualys Government Platform already held FedRAMP High status. Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  4. 2026-03-23 · launch Qualys
    Qualys launches Agent Val for exploit validation in Enterprise TruRisk Management

    Qualys announced general availability of Agent Val, an AI agent within Enterprise TruRisk Management that uses the TruConfirm engine to test whether vulnerabilities are exploitable in live environments, reprioritise confirmed exposures and re-test after mitigation. Qualys (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  5. 2025-09-06 · security incident Qualys
    Qualys discloses limited access to its Salesforce data via Salesloft Drift

    Disclosed by Qualys on 2025-09-06 and reported by BankInfoSecurity on 2025-09-08: stolen OAuth tokens for the Salesloft Drift application gave attackers limited access to some Qualys Salesforce information. Qualys stated there was no impact on its production environments, codebase or customer data on its cloud platform, and that it disabled Drift integrations and engaged Mandiant.
